about: What a Plugin may be granted (decisions Q81, Q97): the core's tables (crates/roster-core/src/plugin/permission.rs) and cases both it and the fake Backend (app/src/backend/fakePlugins.ts) are tested against. The fake reads its tables from here.

network:api.example.com.summary: Send and fetch over the network: api.example.com
network:api.example.com.risk: Can send data to api.example.com and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer.

network:*.example.com.summary: Send and fetch over the network: any site under example.com
network:*.example.com.risk: Can send data to any site under example.com and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer.

network:http://10.0.0.5:8080.summary: Send and fetch over the network: http://10.0.0.5:8080
network:http://10.0.0.5:8080.risk: Can send data to http://10.0.0.5:8080 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. Plain http: anyone on the way can read and change it. That address is on this computer or a private network.

network:[fd00::5]:8443.summary: Send and fetch over the network: [fd00::5]:8443
network:[fd00::5]:8443.risk: Can send data to [fd00::5]:8443 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. That address is on this computer or a private network.

network:http://*.example.com:8080.summary: Send and fetch over the network: any site under example.com over plain http on port 8080
network:http://*.example.com:8080.risk: Can send data to any site under example.com over plain http on port 8080 and fetch from it: anything the Plugin can read (your Hosts, what your Sessions print) could leave this computer. Plain http: anyone on the way can read and change it.
